title: Comment “Resume” and I’ll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you give Claude your resume
description: Comment “Resume” and I’ll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you give Claude your resume and tell it to make it impossible to ignore? I tried this and got 20 responses overnight. Here’s how: Prompt 1: “Act as a senior recruiter for this exact company. Read my resume the way you’d actually read them, skimming for reasons to say no. Tell me the top 3 red flags a hiring manager spots in under 10 seconds.” Claude gives you a brutally honest response. This is exactly what you want. Prompt 2: “Rewrite my experience section to kill those red flags. Lead every line with measurable impact using the Google XYZ formula and strip out every generic phrase.” Here’s the trick: Prompt 3: “Act as both an ATS filter and a hiring manager reading 200 resumes in one sitting. Give me a match score out of 100, tell me which sections would get skipped, and rewrite them so they actually stop the scroll.” Final prompt: “Rewrite my summary so a recruiter feels like passing on me would be a mistake they’d regret.” Claude gives you back a finalized resume recruiters literally can’t ignore. Follow @studyingwithjake for more AI videos. #claude #ai #resume #jobsearch #career #shorts
